answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to tie each attestation to a bonded stake. An agent that splits itself into many fake identities must lock capital for every one, which makes mass duplication expensive. Old misconduct stays on a relic record that lowers trust, while a pearl of verified history rewards consistent honest work. Peer checks then compare vote patterns, and any delta of suspiciously synchronized behavior triggers review before rewards are paid.
